final:
type Shape = Rect(w: int, h: int) | Square(side: int) | Tri(b: int, h: int)

area(s: Shape) -> int =
  post out >= 0
  ex area(Rect(w: 3, h: 4)) == 12
  ex area(Square(side: 5)) == 25
  ex area(Tri(b: 3, h: 5)) == 7
  match s
    Rect(w:, h:) -> w * h
    Square(side:) -> side * side
    Tri(b:, h:) -> b * h // 2
